title: Noun の 前に
shortExplanation: Used to describe a location or position 'in front of' a noun.
longExplanation: The grammar point Noun の 前に is used to describe a location or position 'in front of' a noun. It is formed by adding の 前に after the noun it refers to. (Note that 'Noun の 前に' can also mean 'before [Noun]' in time contexts, but these examples focus on physical location.)

examples.jp: 駅の前にコンビニがあります。
examples.romaji: Eki no mae ni konbini ga arimasu.
examples.en: There is a convenience store in front of the station.

examples.jp: 家の前に車を止めてください。
examples.romaji: Ie no mae ni kuruma wo tomete kudasai.
examples.en: Please park the car in front of the house.

examples.jp: 私の前に彼が立っていました。
examples.romaji: Watashi no mae ni kare ga tatte imashita.
examples.en: He was standing in front of me.

examples.jp: ホテルの前にタクシーが来た。
examples.romaji: Hoteru no mae ni takushii ga kita.
examples.en: A taxi came in front of the hotel.
